item.title: Lubbock weekend lineup includes stargazing, live music and comedy shows
item.description: Lubbock is hosting a variety of events this weekend, from live music and comedy shows to a business expo and family-friendly activities.

item.title: UCF blasts off, stuns No. 11 Texas Tech on the road
item.description: No. 11 Texas Tech rode into the Sunshine State fresh off a huge win over then-No. 6 Houston. Despite a week's worth of rest, the Red Raiders were outclassed by UCF in a stunning 88-79 upset loss.

item.title: 'Mardi Paws!' celebration brings paw-some fun to Lubbock
item.description: Little Woodrow's is getting ready to host their "Mardi Paws!" celebration on Sunday, February 15.

item.title: Lubbock non-profit stacks pancakes and love for charity
item.description: Stacks of Love is coming to the Hub City hosted by Real Deal Cares. Bring out the family for a morning of love, laughter and delicious pancake stacks, all while supporting a great cause.

item.title: Boil water notice lifted for Petersburg residents
item.description: The City of Petersburg has lifted the boil water notice on Sunday, February 1.

item.title: Frogs Croaked: Collins' heroics hop Lady Raiders past TCU
item.description: After a tough loss to Audi Crooks and Iowa State, the No. 21 Lady Raiders welcomed Big 12 leader TCU to United Supermarkets Arena Sunday. The No. 12 Horned Frogs gave Texas Tech all they could handle, but they were able to hold off their rivals for a thrilling 62-60 win.
